WITH SegmentDebt AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.clientseg AS customer_segment,
        t2.debincratio AS debt_to_income_ratio
    FROM 
        core_record AS t1
    JOIN 
        employment_and_income AS t2 ON t1.coreregistry = t2.emplcoreref
),
SegmentStats AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_segment,
        AVG(debt_to_income_ratio) AS avg_debt_to_income_ratio,
        COUNT(customer_segment) AS customer_count
    FROM 
        SegmentDebt
    GROUP BY 
        customer_segment
)
SELECT 
    customer_segment,
    avg_debt_to_income_ratio
FROM 
    SegmentStats
WHERE 
    customer_count >= 3
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Grand Total',
    AVG(avg_debt_to_income_ratio)
FROM 
    SegmentStats
ORDER BY 
    avg_debt_to_income_ratio DESC;

    avg_debt_to_income_ratio
FROM 
    SegmentStats
WHERE 
    customer_count >= 3
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Grand Total',
    AVG(avg_debt_to_income_ratio)
FROM 
    SegmentStats
ORDER BY 
    avg_debt_to_income_ratio DESC;

WITH SegmentDebt AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.clientseg AS customer_segment,
        t2.debincratio AS debt_to_income_ratio
    FROM 
        core_record AS t1
    JOIN 
        employment_and_income AS t2 ON t1.coreregistry = t2.emplcoreref
),
SegmentStats AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_segment,
        AVG(debt_to_income_ratio) AS avg_debt_to_income_ratio,
        COUNT(customer_segment) AS customer_count
    FROM 
        SegmentDebt
    GROUP BY 
        customer_segment
),
GrandTotal AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(avg_debt_to_income_ratio) AS grand_total_avg
    FROM 
        SegmentStats
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(ss.customer_segment, 'Grand Total') AS customer_segment,
    COALESCE(ss.avg_debt_to_income_ratio, gt.grand_total_avg) AS avg_debt_to_income_ratio
FROM 
    SegmentStats ss
CROSS JOIN 
    GrandTotal gt
WHERE 
    ss.customer_count >= 3 OR ss.customer_segment IS NULL
ORDER BY 
    avg_debt_to_income_ratio DESC;
